items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: I thought he had Von Gammann who was playing drums, but I might be wrong about that.

ctx.x: Did you ever go to the Absent House to hear Hal Geordie? He was at 29.

I heard, I'll tell you where I think I heard Hal Geordie, let's see. I heard Hal Geordie when he was playing in a place on Canal Street. I thought he had Von Gammann who was playing drums, but I might be wrong about that. It could have been this guy that lives along the Gulf Coast, might have been playing vibes. I believe his brother plays Saxon Klan at, I don't know what the guy's name. He plays good vibes, very good.
